core_obligations: Reduce the geometric equivalence to the affine algebra statement.

difficulty_reason: For f : X -> S with S locally Noetherian, f is pseudo-coherent if and only if f is locally of finite type. The retained proof reduces to the algebra statement: for R Noetherian and R -> A finite type, A is a pseudo-coherent R-algebra; forward direction is by definition; backward writes A = R[x_1..x_n]/I and cites More on Algebra, Noetherian-pseudo-coherent, that a finitely generated module over a polynomial ring in Noetherian variables is pseudo-coherent as an R[x]-module, i.e. the map is pseudo-coherent. Retained author proof at lines 17479-17490.

dedup.scope: Characterization of pseudo-coherent morphisms in the Noetherian setting.
